zh-Hant.title: 朝拜與童年
zh-Hant.intro: 從聖母訪親、東方博士朝拜，到少年耶穌在聖殿，跟隨耶穌童年的敬拜與成長。
zh-Hant.outro: 耶穌的智慧和身量，並神和人喜愛他的心，都一齊增長。

en.title: Childhood & Worship
en.intro: From the visitation and the magi to the boy Jesus in the temple, follow the worship and growth of Jesus' childhood.
en.outro: Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and people.

hints: 幾位來自東方的訪客帶著禮物。
畫面中的嬰孩被尊為君王。

image.title: 三博士朝拜
image.artist: Fra Angelico 與 Fra Filippo Lippi

zh-Hant.summary: 幾位東方的博士跟隨明星來到伯利恆，俯伏朝拜嬰孩耶穌，並獻上黃金、乳香、沒藥。
zh-Hant.artNote: Fra Angelico 與 Lippi 合作的圓形畫作，將朝拜行列安排在繁複的建築與風景中。

verseHints.text: 「那生下來作猶太人之王的在哪裡？我們在東方看見他的星，特來拜他。」

keyVerse.text: 進了房子，看見小孩子和他母親馬利亞，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭開寶盒，拿黃金、乳香、沒藥為禮物獻給他。

zh-Hant.geoNote: 博士在伯利恆朝拜；該地今屬巴勒斯坦西岸地區，聖誕教堂是傳統地點。

hints: 其中一位年長者已經懷孕。
這是馬利亞探望伊利莎白。
zh-Hant.summary: 馬利亞起身往猶大山地探望伊利莎白，兩人相擁，伊利莎白稱馬利亞為有福的。
zh-Hant.artNote: Ghirlandaio 以拱門與城市背景襯托兩位女子的擁抱，強調信心與盼望的相遇。

verseHints.text: 高聲喊著說：「你在婦女中是有福的！你所懷的胎也是有福的！

keyVerse.text: 這相信的女子是有福的！因為主對她所說的話都要應驗。」

zh-Hant.geoNote: 聖經只說「猶大山地」；傳統將訪親地點與耶路撒冷西郊的 Ein Karem 聯繫起來。

hints: 耶穌十二歲時上耶路撒冷。
他在聖殿裡與教師對話。
他的父母三天後才找到他。
zh-Hant.summary: 耶穌十二歲時在耶路撒冷聖殿與教師對話，父母找到他時，他正以父的事為念。
zh-Hant.artNote: Dürer 以緊湊的人物群像與少年基督的手勢，呈現他在教師中間對話的智慧與專注。

verseHints.text: 耶穌說：「為甚麼找我呢？豈不知我應當以我父的事為念嗎？（或譯：豈不知我應當在我父的家裡嗎？）」

keyVerse.text: 耶穌的智慧和身量（或譯：年紀），並神和人喜愛他的心，都一齊增長。

zh-Hant.geoNote: 路加福音記載耶穌十二歲時在耶路撒冷聖殿與教師對話；確切位置不詳。

hints: Visitors from the East bring gifts.
The child is honored as a king.

image.title: The Adoration of the Magi
image.artist: Fra Angelico 與 Fra Filippo Lippi

en.summary: Magi from the East follow a star to Bethlehem, bow before the child Jesus, and offer gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
en.artNote: A circular panel by Fra Angelico and Lippi places the procession within intricate architecture and landscape.

verseHints.text: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

keyVerse.text: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

en.geoNote: The Magi worshiped in Bethlehem, today in the West Bank; the Church of the Nativity is the traditional site.

hints: Two women embrace at a doorway.
The older woman is already pregnant.
Mary has come to visit Elizabeth.
en.summary: Mary travels to the hill country of Judea to visit Elizabeth; they embrace, and Elizabeth blesses Mary.
en.artNote: Ghirlandaio frames the embrace with an arch and a cityscape, emphasizing a meeting of faith and hope.

verseHints.text: She called out with a loud voice, and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

keyVerse.text: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

en.geoNote: The Gospel says only “the hill country of Judea”; tradition links the visit to Ein Karem, west of Jerusalem.

en.answer: The Boy Jesus in the Temple
options: The Boy Jesus in the Temple
hints: Jesus goes up to Jerusalem at age twelve.
He is found among the teachers in the temple.
His parents find him after three days.
en.summary: At twelve, Jesus stays behind in the Jerusalem temple among the teachers, and his parents find him after three days.
en.artNote: Dürer packs the scene with debating figures and gestures, focusing attention on the young Christ's wisdom and composure.

verseHints.text: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

keyVerse.text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

en.geoNote: Luke places the twelve-year-old Jesus among the teachers in the Jerusalem temple; the exact location is unknown.
